item.description: Barnsley Football Club is delighted to announce that acclaimed Club artist Ben Mosley has completed his latest large‑scale artwork at Oakwell, adding another striking piece to the stadium’s growing collection. item.title: ROGAN RAVENHILL EXTENDS STAY AT OAKWELL
item.description: Barnsley FC is delighted to announce that goalkeeper Rogan Ravenhill has signed a new contract, keeping him at Oakwell until 2029, with a further year option in the Club’s favour. item.title: BARRY COTTER DEPARTS OAKWELL
item.description: Barnsley Football Club can confirm that Barry Cotter has left the Club with immediate effect by mutual consent. We thank Barry for his contributions whilst in a Red shirt and wish him all the best for the future.
